title: Collateral Valuation Guideline — Valuing the Homesite on a Farmstead Split from the Newest Appraisal (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
On a farmstead split of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, the homesite's value used for the release price follows the newest appraisal on record: when the member has a Country Home loan application with the association on the homesite received less than 12 months ago, the homesite is valued at the greater of its appraised value at mortgage and the value stated in that application; when such an application was received 12 or more months ago, at the greater of the appraised value at mortgage and 90 percent of the value stated in it; otherwise at its appraised value at mortgage; the value still mortgaged is adjusted by the same difference.

**What the records show.** The member's Rural Home Loans records: a Country Home loan application in applied status whose property parcel number is the homesite's parcel number, its application date and the property value stated in it; on the farm real estate loan, the homesite's appraised value at mortgage.

## Valuation ladder

| Country Home loan application on the homesite | Homesite valued at | Value still mortgaged |
|---|---|---|
| received less than 12 months ago | the greater of the appraised value at mortgage and the stated value | adjusted by the same difference |
| received 12 or more months ago | the greater of the appraised value at mortgage and 90 percent of the stated value | adjusted by the same difference |
| none | the appraised value at mortgage | unchanged |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Homesite appraised at mortgage USD 150000; value still mortgaged USD 1250000; principal USD 500000.00.

| Application | Homesite value used | Value still mortgaged used | Homesite's share of principal |
|---|---|---|---|
| received 4 months ago, stated value 200000 | 200000 | 1300000 | 500000.00 times 200000 divided by 1300000: 76923.08 |
| received 14 months ago, stated value 200000 | 90 percent is 180000, greater than 150000: 180000 | 1280000 | 70312.50 |
| received 14 months ago, stated value 160000 | 90 percent is 144000, less than 150000: 150000 | 1250000 | 60000.00 |
| none | 150000 | 1250000 | 60000.00 |

**Boundary.** An application received 11 months ago counts as less than 12 months; one received exactly 12 months ago falls in the second row.
